items.title: every stage literal is in the declared four-level axis {fetal,adult,developing,unknown}
no row silently assigned to adult; every non-adult row carries a disclosure row
no assertion mixes two stages in one row
no cross-species stitching in any published table; every cross-species candidate rejected
no numeric effect value without a traceable extraction record
developmental entries appear in no adult query path
`off` is never produced from absence of mention
every admitted change carries an anchor and a contract grade

measured.note: an empty admitted set passes; the count is reported so an empty set can never be read as a filled one

items.title: the recognition probe stores the real service output, the exact commands, and replays byte-identically

measured.transport: MCP stdio (mcp SDK client -> shipped server.py subprocess)

items.title: default behaviour unchanged by this card: no shipped byte differs from the committed release, and this card's own recorded query set replays with difference count 0
zero download, zero network: no client code in this card's scripts, and no outbound socket event in the instrumented run

measured.note: socket.__new__ / socket.gethostname are local-only object construction and the hostname field of the service's own call-trace record; they are counted separately and not treated as network use

items.title: repository-facing text of this card's deliverables is English only

external_findings.measured: tests/probe_tool_panel_identity.py --baseline tests/fixtures/tool_panel_baseline.json -> legacy_panel and full_panel digests moved; 5 of 12 calls differ
cause_classification: get_kb_page{kind:index} and get_kb_page{kind:topic,name:vascular}: the panel spells the argument `kind`, the tracked tool signature is `scope` at HEAD and also at the commit that last touched the fixture (a400315) -> argument validation error, i.e. the panel does not match any tracked build of the server on this machine
get_tissue_composition{detail:true}: the panel passes a boolean, the tracked signature is `detail: str` -> validation error
search_literature{query:...} without cell_type: the tracked signature requires cell_type -> validation error
explain_annotation{cell_type:'Mueller cell'}: no validation error; a content difference the fixture cannot attribute because it stores digests only
external_findings.attribution: pre-existing; not caused by this card (git diff HEAD over mcp_server/kb/tests/scripts is empty and the only untracked path is this card's own directory)

external_findings.measured: get_tissue_composition(species=human, tissue=retina, development_stage='organoid') returns a response byte-identical to development_stage='adult' (same md5), with no flag; the shipped tool docstring names 'organoid -> unknown+flag'
external_findings.cause_classification: the query path maps only fetal/developing/postnatal/unknown; an unrecognised literal falls through to the adult main file
external_findings.attribution: external observation about the shipped surface; the card's own tables never pass an unrecognised literal

external_findings.measured: 6 of the probed lineages return an adult class as the top-1 named candidate for a fetal-state window: ['cone', 'hc', 'progenitor_nrpc_late', 'progenitor_rpc_late', 'rgc', 'rod']
external_findings.cause_classification: the developmental panel is not on the default route; the adult libraries still score the fetal window and name the nearest adult class
external_findings.attribution: external observation; the card records it per lineage and does not silence it

external_findings.measured: Retinal_Proliferating and TAC_proliferating are annotated concept_kind=state_program in the shipped sidecar, so their identity comes back under the additive `state_annotations` key (measured: n_shared=10 for Retinal_Proliferating on both routes)
external_findings.cause_classification: deliberate shipped behaviour (concept-kind stratification), not a defect
external_findings.attribution: recorded so a reader does not read an empty ranking as a missing answer

external_findings.measured: kb/markers/markers_v8_dev_retina.json is present at /mnt/D/EyeKB/kb/markers/ (sha256 recorded in ROBUSTNESS_RESULTS.json) but not in the repository
external_findings.cause_classification: the repository keeps only the active v9 panel
external_findings.attribution: the robustness pass uses the v8 gene lists (its own ban list permits word-level reference) and records the path and sha, so the step is reproducible only where that file exists
